meta_description:
1,056 likes, 33 comments - caparaggupta on October 20, 2026: "Is saal ka Ravan thoda chhota tha 😄
Height kam thi, par jalna to usko bhi tha.

Happy Dussehra 🔥
Ravan ke 10 sar the.

students ke andar bhi kuch Ravan rehte hain, bas dikhte nahi:
	1.	“Kal se pakka” wala Ravan
	2.	5 books ek saath shuru karne wala Ravan
	3.	Revision ko “baad mein” daalne wala Ravan
	4.	Mock test se darne wala Ravan
	5.	Reels mein “bas 5 minute” wala Ravan
	6.	Doosron se compare karne wala Ravan
Aur sabse bada 👇🏻
 7. “Mujhse nahi hoga” wala Ravan

Ravan ek din mein nahi haara tha.
Lanka tak pahunchne mein bhi waqt laga, setu bhi patthar-patthar karke bana.

Aapka target bhi aisa hi hai.
Roz ek patthar. Roz ek chapter.
Is Dussehra bas ek Ravan chuno aur aaj hi jala do.
Sab ek saath nahi. Bas ek. ❤️

#dussehraspecial #caparaggupta #dussehrafestival".
